name: Dukes Retreat
why_special: 1947 hill retreat across 7.5 acres above the Khandala ghats — heritage-style colonial main building, outdoor pool, multi-cuisine Mirage and Olive Garden restaurants. Khandala's longest-running named property and the Tungarli-side ridge alternative to Lonavala resorts.

name: Zara's Resort
why_special: Mid-range resort on the Old Mumbai-Pune Highway 1.5 km from Khandala station — outdoor pool, multi-cuisine restaurant, the value chain pick for Khandala-side weekend trips when Dukes is full.
